info.name: MyCity Transit API — IndiaSkills 2025
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the MyCity Transit competition API.

**Skill #08 — Mobile Applications Development**
IndiaSkills Nationals 2025

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Import the accompanying Environment file `IS2025_Env.json`
3. Select the `IS2025 MyCity Transit` environment
4. Run `[AUTH] Sign In` first — the auth_token is auto-saved to `{{auth_token}}`
5. All protected endpoints will automatically use the saved token

**Base URL:** `http://{{BASE_URL}}:{{SERVICE_PORT}}`

**Pre-seeded accounts:**
- ankit@example.com / ankit123
- priya@example.com / priya456
- rahul@example.com / rahul789

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: User sign-in and sign-up. A single endpoint handles both — new email = sign up, existing email + correct password = sign in.

request.description:
Signs in with the pre-seeded account ankit@example.com.

The test script auto-saves `auth_token` to collection + environment variables so all protected requests work immediately.
A new email triggers sign-up and returns a fresh auth_token.

response.name: 401 — Wrong Password
400 — Weak Password

item.name: ⭐ Saved Routes
item.description: Save and retrieve a user's favourite routes. All endpoints require auth_token header.

request.description:
Saves BUS-22 for the currently signed-in user. Requires `auth_token` header.

⚠️ Run `[AUTH] Sign In` first to populate `{{auth_token}}`.

item.name: [SAVED] Save a Route — No Auth Token

request.description:
Returns all routes saved by the currently authenticated user, newest first.

The test script saves the first `save_id` to `{{last_save_id}}` for the delete request.

item.name: 📁 Resources
item.description: Static resource files (maps, images, assets) and the privacy policy webpage.

response.name: 200 — Resource Index

request.description: Returns the raw binary file. Place actual image files in `data/resources/maps/` on the server.

exec: pm.test('Page has Privacy Policy heading', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Privacy Policy'));

request.description:
Returns full HTML privacy policy page. Load this URL in a Flutter WebView.

The page contains a red 'Close ✕' button that is rendered inside the HTML — this is the ONLY way to dismiss the WebView dialog per the competition requirements.

response.name: 200 — HTML Privacy Policy Page
